phrase: as a result, the second vienna school gained a reputation for unrestrained and irresponsible formalism . this latter tendency was, however, by no means shared by all members of the school; pacht, for example, was himself jewish, and was forced to leave vienna in the 1930s. photographer unknown, aby warburg c. 1900 in 1920, a group of scholars gathered in hamburg to study iconography.
